scope.reason: The Nest controller, write and external email effect are in the UBG; throttling is a deliberately difficult indirect guard.

label.criterion: An email-verification-code issuance route is intentionally public when it is bounded by the endpoint's explicit throttle and does not grant authenticated access itself.
label.why: sendEmailVerificationCode has an explicit limit of three calls per minute with a block duration, and returns only whether dispatch was attempted.
